study_note: TD-AMBI is a trainable AMBI preset using TD-MPC2 actor and critic loss formulas on the AMBI backbone. Both actors use the literal TD-MPC2 scaled entropy with fixed coefficient 1e-4, smooth tanh log-standard-deviation mapping over [-10, 2], the mean of two random critic heads, and Q-only percentile normalization. Both critics use reward-only targets with the minimum of two random heads and distributional cross-entropy weighted by 0.1. Outer losses retain TD-MPC2 temporal reductions with rho=0.5; inner learning retains AMBI transition minibatches without sequence-level rho weighting. Each action-local inner Q scale starts from the outer scale and then applies the running percentile-range EMA on every inner actor update. Inner target critics initialize from the outer target ensemble. This is separate from the evaluation-only TDAMBI wrapper. The Humanoid Walk base-v2 protocol is retained: state observations, seed 55, 14 million decisions, J=8, N=32, H=3, G=1, 768 imagined transitions and eight actor/critic update slots per action. Temperatures are fixed, so no temperature updates or entropy-target tuning are used. Outer and inner actor/critic learning rates are 3e-4 and target-network tau values are 0.01. Controller evaluation, paired controller evaluation, real-environment value evaluation, value-equivalence diagnostics/loss, imagined diagnostics, and periodic/final model saves remain disabled. This remains a single-seed exploratory run and supports no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claim.
